some flexibility in applying the enhanced due diligence procedures on a risk-assessed

account. Comments are sought on all aspects of this proposed rulemaking.

a due diligence program for private banking accounts that is reasonably designed to

statutory.reasoning: The facts show that SYN_16aa30ff, an individual with an expected monthly volume of $2,584, executed five wire transfers totaling well over $100,000, including a $110,768 payment to a newly added payee. Under 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g), a financial institution must file a suspicious activity report when a customer conducts transactions that are unusual in size, pattern, or purpose, and § 5318(g) requires reporting of such suspicious activity; the observed transactions meet this threshold, satisfying the statutory elements of amount, structuring, and new payee, thus the conduct falls within the reporting requirements.
